fact: The Digital Egypt platform offers about 22 online notarial and real-estate-registry services, six of them real-estate-registry services (certified copies of registered contracts, real estate disposals certificate), and on 7 November 2026 the Justice and ICT ministries launched remote issue of a general litigation power of attorney.
title: 22 خدمة إلكترونية للشهر العقاري، أبرزها التوكيلات والإقرارات
